annotations.text:
SEGMENTED CARDS — the build target.

Each group is a #0F3336 card, 1px #17403F border, 12px radius, label set inside at 8px/0.15em. Rows 32px, icon in a 22px tinted square.

Row states:
  rest    rgba(192,232,230,0.66), weight 400
  hover   background #143A3D
  active  background #0E7C86, white, weight 600
  open    background #143A3D, icon #4FC3C9, chevron up

Sub-items indent 19px behind a 1px #1F5155 rail, 28px tall, 12px.

NOTE: the active row is a filled block again. That is a deliberate reversal of the no-pill treatment shipped in 7335b1e — this design carries state with fills rather than brightness.

STILL TO DRAW

The 56px collapsed rail: each card shrinks to a rounded block of icon squares only, with a hand-rolled hover tooltip for labels.

And the <768px overlay drawer.

Both are specified in the design doc but not yet mocked here.

Not chosen — kept for reference.

A — Quiet rail: a 1px rail down the nav column, the active row thickening its segment to 2px teal. Quietest; active cue may be too subtle at arm's length.

C — Editorial amber: typography-led, amber group labels with rules. Most distinctive, but spends the brand amber that signals urgency elsewhere.
